title: When MettleUp's payment server or the payment company has a fault, the desk is told 'No internet' or 'not switched on yet'
what: If MettleUp's payment server fails or the gym's payment company is down, the Payments settings page says online payments are not switched on yet, and the money sheets hide Pay online. Making a payment link in the same state says No internet, try again, even when the internet is fine. The owner is sent looking for the wrong problem, or thinks online payments were turned off.
expected: A server or payment company fault says so in plain words (for example: MettleUp could not reach your payment company just now, use the UPI QR), separate from no internet and from not switched on.
how_often: every payment server or company outage
fix_line: Show a separate message when the payment server or the company fails, and keep the not switched on words for that case only

title: Online payment records and the gyms' payment company connections are not in the nightly backup
what: Online payments, payment links, join-page payments and each gym's sealed payment company keys are kept in a separate Cloudflare database, not in the gym server. The nightly backup copies only the gym server, and the restore guide never mentions the Cloudflare database. If it were damaged, nobody has a written way to bring back which members paid online, and each gym would have to connect its payment company again.
expected: The restore guide covers the payment database too (Cloudflare's own point-in-time restore, or a nightly copy), and one restore of it is tried on a test copy and written down.
how_often: once, on the day a restore is needed
fix_line: Add the payment database to the restore guide and try one restore of it on a test copy

title: If an entry machine's upload arrives broken, its punches are skipped for good
what: When the server cannot read the body of an entry machine's upload, it treats it as empty, answers OK, and still saves the machine's batch marker. On its next call the machine is told the server already holds those punches, so it never sends them again. Those members' visits are missing with no sign anywhere. This part is not switched on yet.
expected: An upload that cannot be read is answered with an error and its marker is not saved, so the machine sends the same punches again.
fix_line: Answer an unreadable upload with an error and do not save its marker

title: When a gym's payment company stops accepting its keys, online payments switch off and nobody is told
what: If the payment company refuses the gym's keys while a link is being made, the server switches that gym's online payments off and writes one hidden log line. The owner finds out only by opening Settings and Payments; members simply stop seeing Pay online. MettleUp is not told either, so we learn of it when the gym asks why nobody pays online.
expected: The owner sees a clear note on Today or gets a message, and MettleUp gets a short report each time a gym's connection is switched off.
how_often: each time a company stops a gym's keys
fix_line: Tell the owner on Today and send MettleUp a short report when a payment connection is switched off

title: Tapping 'I saved it' on an online payment does nothing visible when it fails
what: On Today, a payment made online that could not become a receipt by itself has an I saved it button. If that tap fails (no internet, server fault), the reason goes only to the browser's hidden log. The line stays on screen with no message, so the desk taps again and again without knowing why.
expected: A failed tap says it could not be saved and to try again.
fix_line: Show a short message when I saved it fails

title: After a slow line, trying again to add a branch says the name is already taken
what: If the answer to Add branch is lost on a slow line, the branch is still made on the server. The owner taps Add branch again and is told a branch with this name already exists. The branch is there, but the owner may think something went wrong and add it again under a different name.
expected: A second try with the same name, made seconds later, opens the branch just made instead of refusing it.
fix_line: When the name is taken by a branch made moments ago, show that branch as added

title: MettleUp cannot see how many gyms add branches, connect a payment company, or try the demo gym
what: Adding a branch, connecting a payment company, switching on payments in the member app, opening the demo gym and hitting the Pro pack gate leave no count anywhere MettleUp can read. Decisions on these paid features, and on whether the demo turns visitors into gyms, are made blind.
expected: A small daily count per feature (no names) that HQ can show next to sign-ups and paid gyms.
fix_line: Count branch adds, payment connections, demo opens and Pro gate views per day for HQ

items.reason: Web page: the paid-online check runs every 5 minutes only while the tab is in view and catches up when it comes back; heart rate, watch and screen-off parts do not apply to a web page.
